name: Sayoko
source:
Sayoko is an enigmatic force who consistently obstructs [url=/c176205]Honoka[/url] and [url=/c176206]Juuna[/url]'s noble endeavors. Wrapped in mystery, she doesn't reveal her emotions or show any remorse for her evil deeds. You soon realize that things aren’t as black and white as they appear.

Can you uncover the motivations behind her actions and understand why she stands in the way of your virtuous pursuits? 

[From the [url=https://geniusinc.fandom.com/wiki/I%27m_a_Magical_Girl%27s_Pet%3F!]Genius Inc Wiki[/url]]
